prompt:
A Berlin street corner on a weekday morning, vertical frame. The pavement
is deserted at this hour and the corner belongs to itself. A pedestrian traffic light stands on the right: a grey metal pole carrying
one black lamp housing and rising bare above it against the sky. The housing
holds two round lenses, one above the other; the lower one is dark glass and
the upper one is lit, glowing an even plain red. The road is empty in both directions. A red-painted bicycle
strip with a white bicycle pictogram runs along the pavement, a white zebra
crossing beside it on the asphalt. Behind, a pale cream plastered facade with
tall stone-framed windows and a rusticated ground floor, and black city
bicycles parked in a row against the wall. Grey pavement slabs, a granite
kerb. Daylight, overcast and flat.
